title: Take the Escape, Then the File
setup: Black's king is on h7 with pawns on b6 and f4, your rook is on d6 and the bishop on b4 watches from afar.
hint: The king has three flight squares — for now. Cover it with a move that keeps every other line intact.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rg6}} occupies the square the king needs and gives no check, and nothing Black plays stops {{Rh1#}} — {{f3}} at least asks a question. {{Rh1#}} then mates down the file. Putting a rook where the king wants to go is worth more than putting it where it can check.
